purpose: Preserve a bounded observed distinction between provider-traffic quiescence evidence and OS-process quiescence evidence after the owner FreeSwarm emergency stop. This artifact does not claim host shutdown, provider-runtime acceptance, GRID10 credit, checkpoint credit, J-Space credit or training credit.

evidence.finding: Groq, Mistral, NVIDIA and OpenRouter autonomous provider admission are disabled. The canonical source explicitly states that already-running external OS processes on an unsynchronized execution host must be killed separately.

After the emergency-stop source commit, the host snapshot still contained FreeSwarm supervisor, Forge, Distillery, evaluator and fabric-update process classes. Therefore OS-process quiescence was not established by the source stop alone.

epistemic_boundary: A flat recorded usage counter is evidence that the inspected telemetry did not record new provider usage during the bounded window.
It is not proof that all relevant OS processes were terminated.
It is not proof that no unrecorded or telemetry-blind provider traffic occurred.
It does not authorize a provider request as a test.
It does not promote whole-HCU, whole-EntityOS, checkpoint, J-Space, dataset or training credit.
hypothesis: The owner emergency-stop admission fence prevented new recorded provider work while stale long-lived FreeSwarm-family process shells remained alive.
counterhypothesis: The apparent plateau reflects stale or incomplete telemetry; surviving process shells may still be capable of provider traffic or of resuming it, so direct host-process quiescence remains required.

highest_information_discriminator.action: Use the existing current kill-only emergency-stop path on every provider-capable FreeSwarm execution host without issuing any provider call.
required_receipt: current repository HEAD/source identity used for the stop
post-stop matching process list with zero survivors
bounded before/after provider-usage observation with exactly zero new usage
no paid fallback and no provider probe
highest_information_discriminator.promotion_if_pass: HOST_PROCESS_QUIESCENCE_COMPONENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY; then re-enter current execution authority before any separately pinned GRID10 or checkpoint-input-identity execution.

training_reinjection.lesson: Runtime-control evidence must distinguish process liveness, provider traffic, telemetry freshness and authority. Absence of recorded traffic is not equivalent to process termination.

next_exact_action: Obtain a current host-process quiescence receipt using the kill-only stop path plus a bounded zero-provider-usage delta. Until then do not invoke providers, do not claim runtime quiescence, and do not promote downstream GRID10/checkpoint/J-Space/training gates.
